headword: {渋沢栄一|しぶさわえいいち}
gloss: Shibusawa Eiichi (1840-1931), father of Japanese capitalism

definitions.explanation: A businessman of the Meiji and Taishō periods who helped found around 500 companies, including Japan's first modern bank, and hundreds of schools and charities. He is called the father of Japanese capitalism, and his portrait has been on the 10,000-yen note since 2024.
